senses.sense_definition: A magician, wizard, sorcerer, or practitioner of supernatural magic.

examples.text: The powerful <w>mage</w> cast a protective spell over the entire village.

target_lang_translations.tr: Güçlü <w>büyücü</w> tüm köyün üzerine koruyucu bir büyü yaptı.
target_lang_translations.es: El poderoso <w>mago</w> lanzó un hechizo protector sobre toda la aldea.

examples.text: In many fantasy novels, a young <w>mage</w> must learn to control their magical abilities.

target_lang_translations.tr: Pek çok fantastik romanda, genç bir <w>büyücü</w> sihirli yeteneklerini kontrol etmeyi öğrenmelidir.
target_lang_translations.es: En muchas novelas de fantasía, un joven <w>mago</w> debe aprender a controlar sus habilidades mágicas.

traits.comment: Often used in fantasy literature and gaming contexts

target_lang_definitions.tr: Doğaüstü büyü yapan kimse; büyücü, sihirbaz veya efsuncu.
target_lang_definitions.es: Persona que practica la magia; mago, hechicero o brujo, especialmente en contextos de fantasía.

es.target_lang_sense_clarification: persona que realiza hechizos o conjuros

senses.sense_definition: A Zoroastrian priest; a synonym of <w>magus</w>.

examples.text: The ancient Persian <w>mage</w> performed sacred rituals in honor of the deity.

target_lang_translations.tr: Antik Pers <w>rahibi</w> tanrının onuruna kutsal ritüeller gerçekleştirdi.
target_lang_translations.es: El antiguo <w>mago</w> persa realizaba rituales sagrados en honor a la deidad.

examples.text: Historical texts describe a Persian <w>mage</w> who traveled far to share his wisdom.

target_lang_translations.tr: Tarihi metinler, bilgeliğini paylaşmak için uzaklara seyahat eden bir Pers <w>rahibini</w> tasvir eder.
target_lang_translations.es: Los textos históricos describen a un <w>mago</w> persa que viajó lejos para compartir su sabiduría.

traits.comment: Used in historical or classical contexts

target_lang_definitions.tr: Zerdüştlük dinine mensup rahip; mecusi rahibi.
target_lang_definitions.es: Sacerdote del zoroastrismo en la antigua Persia; sinónimo de mago o magi.

es.target_lang_sense_clarification: sacerdote zoroastriano de la antigua Persia
sacerdote de la religión persa antigua
